title: Code Editor for iPhone and iPad | Acode
description: Edit code on iPhone and iPad with Acode. Work with project files, preview HTML and Markdown, and add tools through community plugins.
heroHeadline: A workspace for code on iPhone and iPad
heroSubheadline: Make a quick fix or work through a small project with a code editor, file browser, previews, and an optional terminal in one app.
problemPoints: Edit code on iPhone and iPad with Acode. Work with project files, preview HTML and Markdown, and add tools through community plugins.
solutionPoints: Acode for iPhone and iPad is currently marked Coming soon on the website. Check the home page for release availability.
featuresHeadline: Code Editor for iPhone and iPad

features.title: Work with project files
features.description: Open files and folders through the system picker. Acode works with locations you authorize; it does not have unrestricted access to your device.

features.title: Preview as you edit
features.description: Check HTML and Markdown while working on your source files. Keep assets and relative links together in a project folder.

features.title: Choose your tools
features.description: Use syntax highlighting and editing features on their own, or open the terminal and add compatible plugins when your workflow needs them.

setupSteps.title: Open a workspace
setupSteps.description: Open Acode and choose a file or folder using the system picker.

setupSteps.title: Edit and save
setupSteps.description: Make your changes in the editor and save them back to your selected location.

setupSteps.title: Check the result
setupSteps.description: Preview HTML or Markdown, or use the terminal for tools supported by the iOS runtime.

faqs.question: Does Acode need a terminal to edit code?
faqs.answer: No. The terminal is optional. You can edit files and preview documents without setting up a command-line workflow.

faqs.question: Can Acode access every folder on my iPhone?
faqs.answer: No. iOS controls file access. Open a supported location through the system picker and grant access to the files you need.
